run.question: Which groups of passages recur across the works of a 13-work philosophy corpus, and how far do they follow the work, translator, original language or genre instead?
run.corpus: 13 public-domain works in English translation from Project Gutenberg (platform/ingest/philosophy/corpus.json), passages from silver.int_philosophy_passages

sample.rule: at most 200 passages per work, evenly spaced (published rule)

text.unit_note: the whole passage as one input (truncated by the model)
text.sample: at most 200 passages per work, evenly spaced (published rule)

pipeline.map: 2-D UMAP of the representation (n_neighbors 15, min_dist 0.1, cosine, first seed)

limitations: Evaluation side holds 7 of 13 works (1,400 sampled passages); every measure is on those works only.
Translator is confounded with work: most works have their own translator, and three English originals share one value.
Groups are computed, not interpreted; their terms are generated and unreviewed.
Champion refitted under the protocol (seeds 10-14, evaluation works only); its numbers differ from the published 13-work run.
CPU rerun: In the rerun (Actions run 41022958155) this run passed every criterion and was the one promoted there.
